name: caretrack
description: CareTrack: An AI-Driven Patient Care Platform for Medication Adherence Tracking and Data-Analytics-Based Automated Reporting

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev" "pnpm --filter @workspace/caretrack run dev"
